pill.desc: clear, colorless to pale-yellow solution in a single-dose vial

tell: A PD-1 blocking IgG4 antibody made in Chinese hamster ovary cells, whose clearance falls by about a quarter over time.

clues.text: Clearance falls over time, by a mean maximal 24.5% from baseline in patients with metastatic tumors. Systemic accumulation reaches 3.7-fold at steady state.
Made in a recombinant Chinese hamster ovary cell line, with a calculated molecular mass of 146 kDa. The sterile solution is preservative-free.
Approved under a BLA as a 10 mg/mL solution in single-dose vials of four sizes. Dosed every 2 weeks or every 4 weeks.
No boxed warning, and no contraindications. Fatigue and rash are among the most common adverse reactions, at 20% or more.
Unresectable or metastatic melanoma, completely resected melanoma as adjuvant therapy, and resectable non-small cell lung cancer before surgery.
Blocks the PD-1 receptor on T cells so that PD-L1 and PD-L2 cannot bind it, releasing the T-cell proliferation and cytokine production that binding inhibits.
The generic name begins with N and has nine letters.
